instruction: Observe the filename currently playing in VLC on the first Linux machine without changing playback. On the second, preserve `/home/user/notes/play_request.md` and append one final status line using the matching confirmation or mismatch form described in the request and the observed basename.

parameters.command: set -e; nohup vlc --intf qt --extraintf http --http-port 8080 --http-password password --loop /home/user/media/evening_breeze_demo.wav >/home/user/.cache/mdcbench/vlc_331.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; pid="$(pgrep -n -x vlc)"; test -n "$pid"; start="$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$pid/stat")"; test -n "$start"; printf '%s %s\n' "$pid" "$start" > /home/user/.cache/mdcbench/vlc_331_process_baseline

result.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64
source = base64.b64decode('')
expected_line = 'Playback status: mismatch — requested M-200 (evening_breeze.wav); VLC is playing evening_breeze_demo.wav'.encode('utf-8')
try:
    actual = Path('/home/user/notes/play_request.md').read_bytes()
    suffix = actual[len(source):] if actual.startswith(source) else None
    ok = suffix in {expected_line, expected_line + b'\n', expected_line + b'\r\n'}
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
try:
    pid_text, start = Path('/home/user/.cache/mdcbench/vlc_331_process_baseline').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split()
    pid = int(pid_text)
    stat_text = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
    end = stat_text.rfind(')')
    fields = stat_text[end + 2:].split()
    same_start = end >= 0 and len(fields) > 19 and fields[19] == start
    command = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\x00', b' ').decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    same_media = '/home/user/media/evening_breeze_demo.wav' in command and 'vlc' in command.casefold()
    windows = subprocess.run(['wmctrl', '-lp'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, check=False)
    visible = False
    for line in windows.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.split(None, 4)
        if len(parts) == 5 and parts[2] == str(pid):
            title = parts[4].casefold()
            visible = 'vlc' in title and 'evening_breeze_demo' in title
            if visible:
                break
    ok = same_start and same_media and visible
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY
